verdict.rationale: The API reference states that official clients wrap the API, installable via `npm install supermemory` (TypeScript) and `pip install supermemory` (Python). Docs across concepts pages show working client code for `client.add` and `client.search`, and a first-party `npx supermemory setup` CLI supports agent-driven integration. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the SDKs, dedicated SDK reference and versioning docs beyond the install line and snippets, and coverage beyond two languages.
